entities.summary: Dobromir Dimitrov is a former Bulgarian male volleyball player. He was part of the Bulgaria men's national volleyball team. He competed with the national team at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, Great Britain. He played now in Club Arman Ardakan. In the summer of 2018 he married former Miss Bulgaria Nansi Karaboycheva.
